tei:titleStmt.tei:title: תְּפִלָּה לִימֵי בְּחִירוֹת
A Prayer for Election Days, by Isaac Gantwerk Mayer (2026)

tei:div.tei:head: A Prayer for Election Days, by Isaac Gantwerk Mayer (2026)

tei:l.tei:note: To be inserted before the חתימה of ברכת המשפט, or else שומע תפילה.

tei:lg.tei:l: May the One who grants governance to governors
and rule to rulers,
and responsibility to citizens,
who raises righteous judges
and lowers wicked tyrants,
bless and illuminate and enlighten
and grant wisdom and understanding
in the hearts of all the voters of this land
on this day of elections,
to vote and choose for themselves
just governors and upright rulers,
who will work and toil and labor
on behalf of the good of the land
and on behalf of the people’s good
and on behalf of the good of all who go about on earth.
But not so for the wicked,
the tyrants and the corrupt,
takers of bribes, men of violence, lowlife ones,
as we said wholeheartedly in the days of our judgment:
“for You will wipe away the arrogant regime from the land.”
Grant us that we raise and bring up judges upright in Your eyes
and in the eyes of all who see us,
as is written in the words of Your teaching:
“Judges and rulers you will grant yourself in all your gates
that the Cause your God gives you for your tribes,
and they will judge the people righteous judgment.” (Deuteronomy 16:18)
And by the hand of Your anointed king who You chose it is written:
“And now, kings, be enlightened,
and be warned, rulers of the earth.” (Psalms 2:10)
And in the words of Your prophets it is written, quote:
“And the Cause raised judges
and they saved them from their despoilers.” (Judges 2:16)
For You hear the cry of the people,
and it will be known among all Your creatures
that a Sovereign who loves righteousness and judgment are You.

tei:note.tei:p: credit to Stephen Belsky for suggesting this line
in the Amidah for the Yamim Noraïm
